sentences.text: This is the first bail application filed by the applicant under Section 483 of BNSS for grant of regular bail relating to Crime No.539/2023 registered at Police Station - Baldevgardh, District- Tikamgarh (M.P.) for the offence punishable under Section 363, 366, 376(2)(n) of IPC and sections 5(1)/6 of POCSO Act.
Applicant is in detention since 28/06/2024.
2. As per the prosecution story, the allegation against the applicant is for committing rape upon the minor prosecutrix.
After investigation, offence under the aforesaid sections has been registered against the applicant.
3. Learned counsel for the applicant submits that applicant is in jail since 28/06/2024.
He has been falsely implicated in this case.
It is submitted that the prosecutrix in her statement recorded under Section 164 of Cr.P.C, has stated that he herself went with the applicant.
She is a consenting party.
Charge sheet has been filed.

Applicant has no criminal past and conclusion of the trial will take considerable time, therefore, it has been prayed that the NEUTRAL CITATION NO.
2024:MPHC-JBP:40367 2 MCRC-33806-2024 applicant may be released on bail.
4. On the other hand, learned counsel for State has opposed the grant of bail to the applicant.
5. Having taken into consideration all the facts and circumstances of the case, but without commenting on merit of the case, I am inclined to release the applicant on bail.
Consequently, bail application under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure for grant of bail filed on behalf of applicant, stands allowed.

sentences.text: It is directed that applicant be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court, for his regular appearance before the trial Court during trial with a condition that he shall remain present before the concerned Court on all the dates fixed by it during trial.

He shall abide by all the conditions enumerated under Section 437(3) of Cr.P.C.
7.
This order shall be effective till the end of the trial.
However, in case of bail jump and breach of any of the conditions of bail, it shall become ineffective.
8. Certified copy as per rules.
